EO 11374 (32 FR 14199, signed 1967-10-11) abolishes the Commission, transfers functions, records and property and pending disputes to FMCS, and by sec. 6 revokes EO 10946 without qualification or savings. The cruden number search (4 hits) shows no other end and no revival, and the history has no flags. The provisional NO is supported with no effective date asserted. Lifecycle gaps remain: the first-effective date, residual effects of the sec. 4-5 transfers, pending disputes and sec. 9 compensation, the absence of a complete later-source search, and page-image confirmation (original_pages_confirmed false).
